make_valid_model: create a valid MJCF model with a body, hinge joint, and velocity actuator
make_broken_model: create an MJCF model with an invalid joint reference to test error handling
break_valid_model: mutate a valid MJCF model by setting its actuator joint to an invalid reference
parse_line_refs: parse the source file for LINE_REF markers and map them to SourceLine tuples
SourceLine: review the SourceLine namedtuple that stores a line_number and text pair for debugging
